'''Dohnia''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

==History==
Dohnia was colonized before the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], establishing the [[Dohnia free colony]]. The [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Ruf-Asti-Viarffli]] was [[President/Legends|President]] of it.
